champions.name: EMBERLING
champions.lore: The youngest of the Hoard, Vexalith's brood. Nobody has ever talked back to it.

champions.name: CINDERA
champions.lore: The walls here are scratched with tally marks: everyone the Hoard threw down before you.

champions.name: ASHKA
champions.lore: The Crew and the Coil pay it to look away. The Burrow and the Old Stone just hide.

champions.name: SCORIA
champions.lore: You can hear the Last Door now, breathing somewhere under the floor.

champions.name: VEXALITH
champions.lore: It has waited at the Last Door a long time for someone who wasn't alone.

premise.title: THE LAST DOOR
premise.banner: Five floors down, and the only way out.
premise.door: It only opens for someone who is not alone.
premise.line: You robbed the Hoard. It threw you down here, five floors above the Last Door.

toll.ask: The gate here drops unless someone holds its chain, and whoever holds it stays.
toll.hold_sub: Nobody stays, and the gate catches you on the way under: %d HP
toll.leave_sub: It holds the gate and stays behind. The others will see
toll.held: You hold it, you run, and the gate catches you going under. %d HP.
toll.left: %s takes the chain and doesn't look at you. You go down without it.
toll.others: Nobody says anything for a long time.

paths.label: THE STEEP STAIR
paths.sub: Tougher monsters below, and a purse on the way down: +6 gold

paths.label: THE QUIET STAIR
paths.sub: Fewer monsters below, and a longer rest on the way: +6 HP

paths.label: THE MARKET STAIR
paths.sub: A trader waits below, and the walk is no easier

paths.label: THE %s WARREN
paths.sub: Every monster below is %s: make friends or enemies in bulk

friend.title: WICK
friend.line: A very small witch hops up and hands you a heart. She lights the torches here.
friend.joined: She has decided to come with you.
